study: Design study · sample member · nothing is sent or saved to your account
title: A little about you.
subtitle: An introduction, a few shared interests. The start of a good conversation.
privateNote: Only the details you choose to share appear on your public profile.
basicsNote: Give the people around the table a familiar face and a name.
photoNote: A photo is optional. Your initials work beautifully, too.
photoLimit: JPG, PNG or WebP · up to 5 MB
photoError: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image smaller than 5 MB.
name: Display name
nameHint: This is the name other members see.
nameError: Add a display name to continue.
bioHint: What are you building, exploring, or happy to talk about?
topicsNote: Small details that make the first hello a little easier.
topicHint: Choose up to five. You can change these anytime.
linkHint: Your website, LinkedIn or GitHub. An HTTPS link.
linkError: Use a complete HTTPS link without a username or password.
previewHint: See your profile through someone else’s eyes.
previewEmpty: A name is enough to pull up a chair.
previewHelp: Hidden details stay off your public profile.
privacyTitle: Share a little. Feel at home.
privacyText: Your email and phone stay private. We never ask where you live.
saved: Up to date in this preview
savedNotice: Changes saved in this design preview only.
bioExample: Building useful things for small businesses. Always up for an honest conversation about starting small.
preferencesNote: Choose your language and how you hear from the community.
languageNote: For the interface and your notifications. Your introduction stays as you wrote it.
pushNote: Event updates on this device. Permission is managed by your browser.
pushState: Not connected in this design study
remindersNote: A timely reminder, so the conversation doesn’t slip your mind.
hostUpdatesNote: Hear when someone joins a gathering you’re hosting.
smsNote: Only if push is unavailable and you choose to add a verified phone number.
securityNote: Private details, sign-in methods, and control over your data.
signInNote: Keep at least one verified way to sign in.
exportNote: Get a private copy of your profile and activity.
deleteNote: Review what is removed and what event records must be retained.
demoBody: This screen shows the design only. In the app, this action requires verification and connects to your account. No account, contact, device or data has been changed.
deleteBody: Your public profile will be hidden and access revoked. Future events you host need cancellation notices. Some event records are retained under the privacy policy. This preview does not delete anything.
activityNote: Your RSVPs and hosted gatherings, together in one place. Only you can see your attendance.
emptyNote: When you join or host a gathering, it will appear here. No scores. No streaks. Just people coming together.
emptyDemo: Event discovery connects to the existing city feed in the app. This design study stays on the profile.
photoDemo: Photo preview is local to this browser tab; no upload was sent.
